description: When planning happens in spreadsheets, knowing who has submitted, what has been approved, and what is still open is usually invisible, tracked through a side list and a round of chasing emails rather than the system itself. The Aimplan Status Visual is built for FP&A teams and planning offices who run the process, and the cost center owners, project leaders, and sales managers who submit and approve their own part of it. The visual shows where each part of the organization stands: not started, in progress, submitted, or approved. Workflow steps are defined centrally in the Aimplan Administration Portal, so the whole organization follows the same process. When a contributor submits their numbers, the Aimplan Planning and Reporting Visual can lock those cells in response, so they cannot be edited again without being reopened, and the same applies on approval. Row-level security and your own DAX measures control who can submit or approve what. Because status is stored against the same dimensions as the rest of your model, it can be reused elsewhere: color-coded on a management overview, used in conditional formatting, or counted and summarized. Every submission and approval is tracked by user and time, giving the process owner a clear, auditable record of where things stand.
